basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon, with a passion for collecting and exchanging cards. My love for design extends to everything I do, including my extensive postcard collection. When I'm not designing or browsing Reddit, you can find me hiking the beautiful trails around the Pacific Northwest or spending time with my two cats, Luna and Pixel. I'm an early riser, usually online between 6 AM and 10 AM PST, before starting my workday. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it brings to explore new hobbies and meet new people online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in graphic design from the University of Oregon, I've spent over a decade honing my craft in both freelance and corporate environments. My expertise in design is complemented by a strong interest in technology, particularly in the areas of VPN usage and online privacy, which I have self-taught through articles and online courses.
